dropzones.name: Aerodrom Chayka
dropzones.status_evidence: Para-Skuf's notice, still its latest news, says no jumps or aircraft flights take place at Chayka under martial law. The text hopes for a return in 2023, so it is a 2022 notice, not exactly dated 24 Feb 2022. Several 2025+ sources show the stop is still in force: Chayka Aero's current Instagram bio says the restrictions on jumps continue, the 2025 Ukrainian national championship was held in Poland, and the EASA bulletin revised 24 Jul 2026 keeps the Ukrainian FIRs closed to civil flights. This is a war suspension, not a permanent closure.

dropzones.name: Aerodrom Tsuniv
dropzones.status_evidence: Every parachute page on the operator's site carries the banner 'parachute jumps are temporarily not conducted'. KAVA, which books the Tsuniv jumps through ZUPA, marks the Tsuniv jump 'temporarily unavailable' on a page with 2026 copyright and newly written FAQ text. The airfield still sells intro flights, so the stop applies to jumping only. The 2025 national championship being held in Poland and the 2026 EASA closure point the same way. This is a suspension (a stop), not a permanent closure.
